description: This source file defines an internal class RemoteSiloProber within the Orleans.Runtime.MembershipService namespace, implementing the IRemoteSiloProber interface. It provides methods to probe remote silos directly and indirectly using a MembershipSystemTarget obtained via dependency injection.

classes.name: RemoteSiloProber
classes.description: An internal class implementing silo probing functionalities for the Orleans membership system.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes a remote silo asynchronously, using a cancellation token.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect probe of a remote silo through an intermediary, with a specified timeout and cancellation support.
